description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionDaoTest' which tests the functionality of the 'EmpUsTaxExemptionDao' data access object related to employee U.S. tax exemption data operations within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao data access object methods including retrieving, saving, and editing employee US tax exemption data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of EmpUsTaxExemptionDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee tax exemption data by employee ID and verifies fields like federal status and exemptions.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee tax exemption record and verifies the saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employee tax exemption record and verifies updated fields.
